data.claim: There is an unresolved rivalry over whether the append-only event log requires RFC 9110 idempotence simpliciter or a stronger, log-specific property. One position (ART_1, ART_2, ART_4, ART_5, ART_7, ART_8, ART_10) holds that the log requires idempotence in the RFC sense. The opposing position (ART_3, ART_6, ART_9) holds that the log requires a property distinct from or strictly stronger than RFC idempotence because RFC idempotence is order-insensitive and defined over individual method semantics, not ordered operation sequences.
